<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" height="100%">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bgGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#0a0c16"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#12182b"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="glow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="4" result="blur"/>
      <feComposite in="SourceGraphic" in2="blur" operator="over"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>
  <rect width="800" height="600" rx="16" fill="url(#bgGrad)" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="400" y="45" font-family="Prompt, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="bold" fill="#fbbf24" text-anchor="middle" filter="url(#glow)">☯ ผังดวงชะตา BaZi 4 เสา (Four Pillars of Destiny)</text>
  <text x="400" y="75" font-family="Prompt, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#94a3b8" text-anchor="middle">True Solar Time (TST): 1990-05-15 14:15:53 | Day Master: 庚 (Metal Yang)</text>
  <g transform="translate(60, 100)">
    <rect x="10" y="10" width="140" height="320" rx="12" fill="#1e293b" fill-opacity="0.6" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="80" y="35" font-family="Prompt, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#94a3b8" text-anchor="middle">เสายาม</text>
    <rect x="25" y="50" width="110" height="110" rx="10" fill="#8b5cf6" fill-opacity="0.15" stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="80" y="115" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="46" font-weight="bold" fill="#8b5cf6" text-anchor="middle">癸</text>
    <text x="80" y="145" font-family="Prompt, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#e2e8f0" text-anchor="middle">Guǐ (Water)</text>
    <rect x="25" y="180" width="110" height="110" rx="10" fill="#d97706" fill-opacity="0.15" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="80" y="245" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="46" font-weight="bold" fill="#d97706" text-anchor="middle">未</text>
    <text x="80" y="275" font-family="Prompt, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#e2e8f0" text-anchor="middle">Wèi ()</text>
    <rect x="170" y="10" width="140" height="320" rx="12" fill="#1e293b" fill-opacity="0.6" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="240" y="35" font-family="Prompt, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#94a3b8" text-anchor="middle">เสาวัน</text>
    <rect x="185" y="50" width="110" height="110" rx="10" fill="#38bdf8" fill-opacity="0.15" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="240" y="115" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="46" font-weight="bold" fill="#38bdf8" text-anchor="middle">庚</text>
    <text x="240" y="145" font-family="Prompt, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#e2e8f0" text-anchor="middle">Gēng (Metal)</text>
    <rect x="185" y="180" width="110" height="110" rx="10" fill="#d97706" fill-opacity="0.15" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="240" y="245" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="46" font-weight="bold" fill="#d97706" text-anchor="middle">辰</text>
    <text x="240" y="275" font-family="Prompt, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#e2e8f0" text-anchor="middle">Chén ()</text>
    <rect x="330" y="10" width="140" height="320" rx="12" fill="#1e293b" fill-opacity="0.6" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="400" y="35" font-family="Prompt, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#94a3b8" text-anchor="middle">เสาเดือน</text>
    <rect x="345" y="50" width="110" height="110" rx="10" fill="#38bdf8" fill-opacity="0.15" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="400" y="115" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="46" font-weight="bold" fill="#38bdf8" text-anchor="middle">辛</text>
    <text x="400" y="145" font-family="Prompt, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#e2e8f0" text-anchor="middle">Xīn (Metal)</text>
    <rect x="345" y="180" width="110" height="110" rx="10" fill="#ef4444" fill-opacity="0.15" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="400" y="245" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="46" font-weight="bold" fill="#ef4444" text-anchor="middle">巳</text>
    <text x="400" y="275" font-family="Prompt, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#e2e8f0" text-anchor="middle">Sì ()</text>
    <rect x="490" y="10" width="140" height="320" rx="12" fill="#1e293b" fill-opacity="0.6" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="560" y="35" font-family="Prompt, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#94a3b8" text-anchor="middle">เสาปี</text>
    <rect x="505" y="50" width="110" height="110" rx="10" fill="#38bdf8" fill-opacity="0.15" stroke="#38bdf8" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="560" y="115" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="46" font-weight="bold" fill="#38bdf8" text-anchor="middle">庚</text>
    <text x="560" y="145" font-family="Prompt, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#e2e8f0" text-anchor="middle">Gēng (Metal)</text>
    <rect x="505" y="180" width="110" height="110" rx="10" fill="#ef4444" fill-opacity="0.15" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="560" y="245" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="46" font-weight="bold" fill="#ef4444" text-anchor="middle">午</text>
    <text x="560" y="275" font-family="Prompt, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#e2e8f0" text-anchor="middle">Wǔ ()</text>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(60, 450)">
    <text x="0" y="0" font-family="Prompt, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#fbbf24">⚖️ สัดส่วนสมดุล 5 ธาตุ (Five Elements Harmony)</text>
    <text x="0" y="28" font-family="Prompt, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#10b981">Wood: 6.3%</text>
    <rect x="0" y="35" width="120" height="10" rx="5" fill="#334155"/>
    <rect x="0" y="35" width="7" height="10" rx="5" fill="#10b981"/>
    <text x="135" y="28" font-family="Prompt, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#ef4444">Fire: 34.6%</text>
    <rect x="135" y="35" width="120" height="10" rx="5" fill="#334155"/>
    <rect x="135" y="35" width="41" height="10" rx="5" fill="#ef4444"/>
    <text x="270" y="28" font-family="Prompt, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#d97706">Earth: 31.2%</text>
    <rect x="270" y="35" width="120" height="10" rx="5" fill="#334155"/>
    <rect x="270" y="35" width="37" height="10" rx="5" fill="#d97706"/>
    <text x="405" y="28" font-family="Prompt, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#38bdf8">Metal: 21.2%</text>
    <rect x="405" y="35" width="120" height="10" rx="5" fill="#334155"/>
    <rect x="405" y="35" width="25" height="10" rx="5" fill="#38bdf8"/>
    <text x="540" y="28" font-family="Prompt, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#8b5cf6">Water: 6.6%</text>
    <rect x="540" y="35" width="120" height="10" rx="5" fill="#334155"/>
    <rect x="540" y="35" width="7" height="10" rx="5" fill="#8b5cf6"/>
  </g>
</svg>
